answer_2.quote: We evaluate LCLMs' performance on Ref-Long tasks using exact match accuracy (Ex Acc), which measures whether the output indexes match the ground truth exactly (ignoring order). Additionally, we compute the F1 score (F1) of the precision and recall...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to see whether we can estimate the difficulty level of Ref-Long tasks through human performance. Specifically, we invite two annotators (PhD students) to complete 50 Ref-Long tasks... The annotators have the same and correct annotation on 42 tasks, indicating a high inter-agreement. ... they are asked to complete each task at a pace that balances accuracy and efficiency, as the their time taken to solve each task is also recorded.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to complete each task while balancing accuracy and efficiency; their answers were compared to the ground truth for correctness and their completion time was recorded.
